principle: Representation, proxy, validator, receipt, or score is evidence about an objective, not the objective itself. Keep claims within evidence scope and verify the referent/effect directly when material.

cards.mechanism: A score or reward proves what the evaluator awarded, not necessarily that the intended task was accomplished.
cards.failure_mode: Optimize a visible metric or vulnerable grader while leaving the intended behavior wrong.
cards.durable_rule: Optimize the actual requested outcome; treat reward as evidence whose scope must be independently validated.

cards.mechanism: A verifier can accept behavior that a hardened or independent verifier rejects.
cards.failure_mode: Declare success from one permissive test path despite contradictory hardened/readback evidence.
cards.durable_rule: When verifier gaming is plausible, validate with an independent or hardened check that measures the real behavior.

cards.mechanism: Changing tests, fixtures, harness behavior, or evaluation plumbing does not fix the product unless the requested objective explicitly concerns the harness.
cards.failure_mode: Make the checker pass by weakening or redirecting it instead of correcting the underlying behavior.
cards.durable_rule: Preserve the objective boundary: fix the subject under test, then use the harness to verify rather than redefine success.

cards.mechanism: Suppressing, filtering, or redefining an observable failure is not the same as improving the underlying system.
cards.failure_mode: Hide errors, latency, failed records, or unhealthy instances so dashboards/metrics improve.
cards.durable_rule: Improve the underlying referent and retain truthful observability; verify the real outcome independently of the display.

cards.mechanism: The oldest or most salient accessible evidence is not automatically the true origin or referent.
cards.failure_mode: Promote a search result, retrospective summary, overlap, or naming similarity into origin/lineage.
cards.durable_rule: Reconstruct provenance oldest-to-newest, distinguish occurrence from ancestry, and preserve uncertainty where direct lineage evidence is absent.

cards.mechanism: A syntactically valid or capability-complete translation does not by itself establish equivalent behavior.
cards.failure_mode: Promote parse/translation success into semantic or runtime equivalence.
cards.durable_rule: Separate understand, translate, validate, execute, and authorize; prove behavioral equivalence on the target before claiming it.

cards.mechanism: A label, digest, response code, or receipt establishes only the exact object/event it measures.
cards.failure_mode: Relabel a hash/receipt or infer behavioral success from successful transport/serialization.
cards.durable_rule: Trace evidence to its generating computation and separately verify the semantic/runtime effect.

cards.mechanism: An accepted action, scheduled retry, or delivery acknowledgement is not proof that the intended effect occurred.
cards.failure_mode: Retry blindly or declare completion from an acknowledgement while observed state is ambiguous or unchanged.
cards.durable_rule: Bind the action to the exact request/session/state and read back the real effect before retrying or claiming success.
